headline: AI-driven growth lifted revenues but profit margins varied across the sector in Q2 FY27.
summary: Top‑line growth was strong for most majors, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY revenue jump. TCS and Tech Mahindra posted solid double‑digit growth, while Infosys trimmed its FY guidance to 1‑2% revenue growth. Profit margins diverged, with HCLTech and Coforge expanding margins, but Infosys and Wipro saw modest or falling profits. AI revenue contributions rose sharply, especially at TCS, HCLTech and LTM.

themes.title: AI as a revenue catalyst
themes.detail: AI revenue grew double‑digit YoY at several firms, underpinning deal wins and margin expansion.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and highlighted modest outlook, while other peers kept guidance unchanged.

themes.title: Margin pressure and attrition
themes.detail: Operating margins slipped at Infosys and Wipro amid higher attrition, whereas Coforge and HCLTech improved margins.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY guidance was cut to a 1‑2% range.

domain_outlook.note: No explicit references to entertainment or streaming deals.
Gaming was not cited in any report.
